top_concerns: Section 5 'proof' of dominating experts relies on unbounded expert weight norms and a Gaussian toy model; it does not support dormant-expert dominance in trained MoEs

Ablations show expert probing and trigger optimization add only ~1-10 ASR points; baselines are not parameter-matched (LoRA on attention only vs. extra trained experts) and look broken (~50% on IMDB, ~0% on Samsum), with no seeds/variance
Method/implementation inconsistency (LoRA on attention 'avoiding experts' vs. tuning dormant experts) and no direct evidence that triggered inputs route to and depend on the infected experts
Defense evaluation is narrow (ONION, fine-prune, fine-tune); no MoE-specific or adaptive defenses; the >80% ASR claim covers only some settings
Utility/stealth claims overstated: 'clean' is untuned base, unrelated-task degradation, trigger PPL in the hundreds to thousands; only base models and one layer tested
